source: AHA PALS 2025 Instructor Manual — Module 4 (Testing) + Module 5 Appendix A (12 Case Scenario Testing Checklists, OCR'd VERBATIM) + Module 5 Appendix B (16 Practice Case Scenarios) + Module 5 Testing Case Scenario section (16 testing case narratives) + Module 6 (Lesson Plans).
_supersedes: v1.0 seed, which was reverse-engineered from the Group-13 (2020) Google form. v1.0 criteria were 2020, incomplete (missing the septic-shock antibiotics step entirely), had no obstructive-shock checklist, no instructor prompts, no scope-conditional flags, and used 2020 case_codes (PALS_TEST_7/9/13). ALL REPLACED.
model_summary: PALS grading is NOT the ACLS megacode segment chain. A PALS testing scenario = ONE FLAT CHECKLIST of Critical Performance Steps for that pathophysiology. Steps 1-2 (team-leader preamble) are the first two steps of every checklist. Graded PER STUDENT (the selected Team Leader). Outcome = PASS / NR (Needs Remediation). See PALS_Grading_Model_Spec.md.

testing.pass_rule_detail: AHA: 'If the student does not complete all steps successfully (as indicated by at least 1 blank check box), the student must receive remediation.' MODIFIED FOR SCOPE: a step outside the tester's scope of practice is marked N/A and is NOT a blank box. Pass = every IN-SCOPE step checked.
testing.graded_unit: the selected Team Leader (per student); all other participants recorded as team members on the attempt
testing.remediation_notes: free text, required by AHA when NR

practice.detail: Practice uses the SAME checklist criteria as the matching testing category (so practice rehearses exactly what testing grades), but FORMATIVE: no PASS/NR. Records the 0-4 team-leader rubric.

skills.detail: NOT graded in the app UI. Instructor verifies in class; app stores attestation + emits a printable completed AHA competency sheet into the student's export file. Exception path: fail -> remediation documentation. Printable form must closely mimic the AHA skill/scenario testing form.

scope_of_practice.principle: Class is mixed-discipline (paramedic, RN, MD, RT). A step outside the tester's scope is N/A — not graded, not a failure.
examples: RN generally cannot intubate -> advanced-airway steps = N/A
Paramedic generally has no antibiotics -> 'Directs early administration of antibiotics' = N/A
Paramedic: chest tube / chest x-ray = N/A (needle decompression IS in scope and IS graded)
scope_of_practice.student_field: discipline (paramedic | rn | md | rt | other) — pre-suggests N/A, instructor-overridable

course_completion.scenario_testing: 3 case scenarios run (Shock, Respiratory, Cardiac); must PASS 2. AHA minimum = 2 case scenario tests, satisfiable as Team Leader OR a team member. ⚠ Per-student pass must NOT require 2 TL runs.
course_completion.team_leader_practice_requirement: ⚠ MANDATORY (AHA Module 6, Lesson 12): 'Every student must act as Team Leader at least TWICE in the full PALS Course.' This is a PRACTICE requirement. With 6-student groups x 12 practice cases = exactly 12 TL turns = 2 each, ZERO slack. Groups >6 break the requirement.
course_completion.practice_case_count: Full PALS Course = 12 practice cases: 4 Respiratory, 4 Shock, 4 Arrhythmia. 25 min each (5 prebrief / 10 sim / 10 debrief).
course_completion.bls_skills: Child CPR & AED Skills Test + Infant CPR Skills Test (AHA PALS 2025 Lesson 5 — NEW). Program covers child/infant BLS in its ACLS BLS block (class split adult vs infant/peds); records carried into the PALS student file via the skills export. Contingency: 30 min if re-test required.
course_completion.retest: May immediately retest once if time permits; otherwise end-of-course remediation lesson. Retest the ENTIRE scenario. Remediation + retesting must complete within 30 days.

selection_policy.note: AHA 2025 prescribes RANDOM DRAW from card pools (Test 1 = 4 cardiac cards; Test 2 = 8 respiratory/shock cards). The program deliberately uses TARGETED SELECTION instead.
selection_policy.documented_rationale: Cases are selected to (a) match available manikin fidelity (inventory: neonate high-fidelity, infant, toddler — NO school-age or adolescent manikin), (b) target documented local performance gaps identified by the accrediting body and partner agencies, and (c) calibrate challenge level for a paramedic-scope, prehospital audience.
selection_policy.age_adjustment: Instructors may down-age a case (e.g. 7 yr -> 3-4 yr) to match manikin fidelity, adjusting vitals to remain age-appropriate. App must support age_adjustable + surface age-banded vital ranges so the adjustment stays clinically coherent.

instructor_controls.scripted_prompts: Display instructor_prompt text VERBATIM. AHA forbids ANY other hint or coaching ('without any assistance, hints, or prompting'). The printed prompt is the ONLY sanctioned prompt.
instructor_controls.critical_actions_briefed_up_front: AHA requires students be told which actions force a no-pass (e.g. failure to confirm airway placement, shocking a perfusing rhythm).

criteria.text: Assigns team member roles
Uses effective communication throughout
Identifies cardiac arrest
Directs immediate initiation of high-quality CPR, and ensures performance of high-quality CPR at all times
Directs placement of pads/leads and activation of monitor/defibrillator
Identifies VF or pulseless VT cardiopulmonary arrest
Directs safe performance of attempted defibrillation at 2 J/kg
After delivery of every shock, directs immediate resumption of CPR, beginning with chest compressions
Directs establishment of IO or IV access

Directs preparation and administration of appropriate dose of antiarrhythmic (amiodarone or lidocaine) at appropriate time

vitals_convention: Where AHA prints two different values for the same vital (vitals box vs primary assessment), BOTH are carried as a PROGRESSION, not a contradiction: the box = PRESENTING value; the primary assessment = what the team finds on their own assessment moments later. Applies to PALS_TEST_CASE_07 and PALS_PRACTICE_09.
